value.rationale: A canonical family of posets with unbounded order dimension n nevertheless has rowmotion order uniformly bounded by 30. A complete all-n classification identifies the exact transition from universal rank mean n at n=3 to two incompatible rank averages on equal-length orbits for all n>=4. This is a structural dynamic theorem on a natural family rather than a routine evaluation of a small finite case.
